patch.value: Transactional preview portability: canonical race fixtures and persistent invalid-path recovery

GH-1377/1378/1380 expose separate portable-boundary regressions in the semantic-preview acceptance added by pm-gh1370: race injection compares unresolved aliases to canonical paths, a search cursor fixture hashes an unresolved Windows root, and ENOENT below a regular file is incorrectly treated as disappearance on Windows. Repair concrete causes and make these contracts mandatory before merge without weakening assertions or platform coverage.

Canonical settings race injection executes on physical and aliased roots across macOS Windows and Linux;Persistent invalid intermediate path errors retain native diagnostics while vanished entries retain retryable conflicts;Search cursor continuation fixture hashes the actual resolved tracker;Required platform checks exercise settings search and snapshot cases with unchanged assertions;Full-source coverage remains 100/100/100/100
